datasets.name: ASOS: Automated Surface Observing System
datasets.precipitation_basis: Gauge-based (heated tipping-bucket and AWPAG weighing gauges)
datasets.period_of_record: June 1998 - Present (1-minute data; hourly reports go back further at some stations)
datasets.update_status: Ongoing; NCEI's 1-minute files and GHCNh are updated daily.
datasets.spatial_coverage: United States: 50 states, Puerto Rico, U.S. Virgin Islands and some Pacific territories
datasets.curator: NWS ASOS program office (Kenneth Boutin, National Program Manager in 2024); NOAA NCEI archives the data
datasets.notes: Network of about 950 automated weather stations, mostly at airports, run jointly by NWS, FAA and DoD, and scored here as one dataset across its products. Precipitation comes from a heated tipping-bucket gauge or the newer AWPAG weighing gauge, with freezing-rain and present-weather sensors. Amounts are in the 1-minute page 2 files (DSI 6406) and the hourly METAR/SPECI reports, now archived in GHCNh (ISD, which held them before, stopped updating in August 2025). NCEI is the archive of record; the Iowa Environmental Mesonet keeps an independent archive. No DOI for the network.

datasets.name: USCRN Daily: U.S. Climate Reference Network Daily Products
datasets.spatial_coverage: United States: contiguous U.S., Alaska and Hawaii
datasets.temporal_frequency: Daily (5-minute, hourly and monthly products also available)
datasets.curator: Howard Diamond (NOAA ARL), USCRN Program Manager
datasets.notes: Reference-quality climate network: 141 stations (114 in the contiguous U.S., 25 in Alaska, 2 in Hawaii), run by NOAA's Atmospheric Turbulence and Diffusion Division (ATDD). Precipitation comes from a Geonor T-200B weighing gauge with three sensors, read every 5 minutes and summed into daily values; a tipping-bucket gauge is for comparison only. The daily files also hold temperature, humidity, solar radiation and soil values. Archived and served by NOAA NCEI.

datasets.name: GHCN-D: Global Historical Climatology Network Daily
datasets.update_status: Ongoing; updated daily, with the full dataset rebuilt about each weekend.
datasets.notes: Point observations from more than 100,000 land stations in about 180 countries, compiled from about 30 source networks. Not a gridded product, and not homogenized for changes in instruments or observing practice.

access_endpoints.name: GHCN-D: Registry of Open Data on AWS

datasets.name: CoCoRaHS: Community Collaborative Rain, Hail and Snow Network
datasets.data_archive: CoCoRaHS (Colorado State University); NOAA NCEI (copy in GHCN-Daily)
datasets.update_status: Ongoing; daily reports, entered through the day as volunteers submit them.
datasets.spatial_coverage: North America: U.S., Canada, Puerto Rico, U.S. Virgin Islands and the Bahamas
datasets.temporal_frequency: Daily (plus event reports for hail and intense rain)
datasets.curator: CoCoRaHS headquarters, Colorado Climate Center (Colorado State University)
datasets.notes: Volunteer citizen-science network started in Colorado in 1998. About 28,000 observers read a standard 4-inch manual rain gauge at about 7 a.m. each day, and also report snowfall, snow depth and hail. Point observations, not gridded. The CoCoRaHS database is the archive of record; NOAA NCEI receives a daily stream into GHCN-Daily. No DOI or version number.

access_endpoints.name: NOAA NCEI GHCN-Daily (copy of the CoCoRaHS reports)

datasets.name: GPCP Daily v3.3: Global Precipitation Climatology Project
datasets.precipitation_basis: Satellite + gauges; constrained to GPCP monthly
datasets.update_status: Ongoing; updated monthly, with a processing delay.
datasets.notes: Merged satellite and gauge analysis: IMERG V07 Final (V07 Late for October–December 2025), GridSat infrared and GPCC gauges, constrained to the GPCP monthly analysis. Computed at the University of Maryland and archived at NOAA NCEI. Replaces the 1° V1.3 One-Degree Daily product.

datasets.name: IMERG Late Run V07: Integrated Multi-satellitE Retrievals for GPM
datasets.precipitation_basis: Satellite (passive microwave + IR); climatological gauge adjustment
datasets.update_status: Ongoing; near real time, about 12–14 hours after observation.
datasets.spatial_coverage: Global land + ocean, 90°S-90°N (small gaps near the poles)
datasets.notes: NASA Level-3 multi-satellite precipitation from the GPM mission (NASA and JAXA). The Late Run is for near-real-time use and uses a climatological gauge adjustment; the Final Run uses monthly gauge analyses, so the two are different products. Archived at NASA GES DISC.

datasets.name: PERSIANN-CDR v1r1 Daily
datasets.update_status: Ongoing; updated quarterly, about three months behind real time.
datasets.temporal_frequency: Daily (monthly/yearly aggregations also distributed by CHRS)
datasets.notes: Daily precipitation estimated from geostationary infrared imagery (GridSat-B1) by an artificial neural network trained on NCEP Stage IV, then bias-adjusted to GPCP v2.2 monthly. Long satellite-based record, useful in gauge-sparse regions. Developed at UC Irvine CHRS; archived and stewarded by NOAA NCEI.
